description: [DEPRECATED] Get a token's on-chain metadata (display name, decimals, EIP-712 version) for a given chain. Needed when building an EIP-3009 deposit signature's tokenName/tokenVersion fields. Rate limited to 6 calls/minute per caller, no more than one call every 10s.

chain.description: Chain name, e.g. BASE, ETHEREUM, POLYGON.

token.description: Token symbol, e.g. USDC, USDT, MUSD, RLUSD, USDG, USDE, PYUSD.

name: get_token_info
title: Get token info
